newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Delta sees Hartley start by end-1997.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Delta sees Hartley start by end-1997.

text.p: Delta Gold NL said on Thursday it expected to reach full mining and production capacity at its Hartley platinum mine in Zimbabwe before the end of 1997.

Chairman Peter Vanderspuy told Delta's annual meeting that joint venture partner Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd and Delta should also have concluded an analysis by then to enable a decision to be made on whether to expand the operation.
Commenting on project delays, to which Vanderspuy said the market had reacted negatively, he told shareholders the first sod was turned 26 months ago.
"We expect to be selling metal before next June, less than 36 months from the start of construction," he said.
"The bottom line outcome is that the Hartley platinum mine is on track to achieve the metal output and time-table established by the feasibility study," he said.

Vanderspuy said Delta expected to complete a pre-feasibility study of the nearby Ngezi platinum project over the next three months. "Assuming positive outcomes, which I expect, the Delta board will then consider commissioning a fully bankable independent feasibility study for completion and a possible project go-ahead decision before this time next year," he said.
